faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in La Cañada Flintridge?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the La Cañada Flintridge building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in La Cañada Flintridge?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and La Cañada Flintridge rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my La Cañada Flintridge remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
